The table lists every atom of one conventional cell (cell parameters in the first line of the table) of calcite (CaCO3, COD 1547350). Treat the crystal as infinite and periodic. Around the Ca atom at fractional (0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000), how many O atoms lie at the shortest Ca–O distance (atoms within 0.001 Å of it count as the same distance), and what is that distance? Distances are rounded to 0.001 Å.

选项：
A. 6 at 4.047 Å
B. 1 at 2.364 Å
C. 6 at 3.454 Å
D. 6 at 2.364 Å

附件：EN-COD1547350-COORD-Ca-O-cell.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：常规晶胞按 CIF 全部对称操作展开（task_families/cell.py）；周期晶体；衍射题为运动学模型与原子序数权重。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
